remainingGaps.details: Fresh searches and official Cook candidate-filing/Chicago election pages did not yield readable general roster. Clerk candidate-filing URL returned HTTP 402; Chicago pages inaccessible/403. Existing campaign and endorser evidence is not certification.

October 21 Clerk Proviso specimen reproduced by NoticeRegistry lists Miranda E. Hernandez, Democratic, Commissioner 16th; no direct publisher/original certified file retrieved. Retain limitation rather than call it directly verified by county.

June official list remains available as indexed official-domain text and matches represented names. County resources advertises August 24 update, but browser retrieval and direct public HTTP request both returned access denied.
